bottommost.rival_program:
(rule!
 (let ()
   (define (yellow-rows c)
     (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 4)) (range h)))
   (define anchor-column
     (first (filter (lambda (c) (= (length (yellow-rows c)) 1))
                    (range w))))
   (define anchor-row (first (yellow-rows anchor-column)))
   (define (chosen-row c) (last (yellow-rows c)))
   (grid-from-fn h w
     (lambda (r c)
       (if (= r (chosen-row c)) 4 0)))))
bottommost.selected_program:
(rule!
 ;; Per column, keep only the FIRST yellow(4); everything else clears.
 (let ()
   (define (row-with-four c)
     (first (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 4)) (range h))))
   (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (= r (row-with-four c)) 4 0)))))

farthest_anchor.rival_program:
(rule!
 (let ()
   (define (yellow-rows c)
     (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 4)) (range h)))
   (define anchor-column
     (first (filter (lambda (c) (= (length (yellow-rows c)) 1))
                    (range w))))
   (define anchor-row (first (yellow-rows anchor-column)))
   (define target anchor-row)
   (define (better? a b)
     (let ([da (abs (- a target))]
           [db (abs (- b target))])
       (or (> da db) (and (= da db) (< a b)))))
   (define (chosen-row c)
     (first (sort (yellow-rows c) better?)))
   (grid-from-fn h w
     (lambda (r c)
       (if (= r (chosen-row c)) 4 0)))))
